item.title: City of Chattanooga Closes Facilities, Programs for the Weekend
item.description: CHATTANOOGA, Tenn. — The City of Chattanooga is closing all facilities and programs for January 24 and 25 due to inclement weather. They say essential employees will report to work as usual. Categories: Chattanooga, Featured Tags: Chattanooga, Closed, inclement weather, Weather

item.title: Toyota recalls 162,000 trucks over faulty screens
